body: This PR is a draft again, to fix the review finding of 5b16ed7e4. I will merge `main` into the branch (no rebase, no force-push) and add `break_through_from` to the `OpParams::Drill` initializers of the tests. Then I will run the gate again and flag the PR ready again.

Review fix pushed. Head: 79e288c5f. No rebase, no force-push.

1. Merge commit a79edd815 merges `main` (8643d9bb7) into the branch. There was no conflict and no hand edit.
2. Commit 79e288c5f adds `break_through_from: BreakThroughFrom::FullDiameter` to the two `OpParams::Drill` initializers in the tests:
   - `crates/app/src/operation/drill_size_tests.rs` (the finding);
   - `crates/ui/src/detect_holes_note_tests.rs` (the same struct, in the GUI test).
3. `crates/app/src/script/api.rs::holds_post` (new on main) reads `blocks_post()`. Thus the advisory `DrillUndersize` needs no arm there.

Quick gate on 79e288c5f (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`): 328 steps, 323 green, 5 failed. None comes from this change:

- `thread_boss::an_external_m8_thread_verifies_clean_and_posts_helical_moves` and `thread_mill::a_multi_form_mill_threads_m8_clean_and_posts_helical_moves`: the goldens `thread_mill_external_m8_multi_form.nc` and `thread_mill_m8_multi_form.nc` are stale. Only the tool numbers differ (T01 and T03 change places). The two suites fail the same way on a clean worktree of `main` at 8643d9bb7. The post-merge runs of 7b4dc0d89 and 6a3e211f2 also failed.
- `first_part_programs` (2 tests) and `wire_taper_angle`: they fail the same way on clean `main` on this Windows machine (see the PR body).
- `ui lib`: `setup_mount_pages::each_setup_picks_its_own_machine_and_post_and_posts_one_file_per_mount`. This is the known timing failure of the setup pages at `--test-threads=16` on clean `main`.

The pinning tests on 79e288c5f: `drill_size` (4), `drill_undersize` (3), `drilling_axial` (7), and the GUI `detect_holes` tests (4) are green.

The PR is ready for review again.
